# noozle_aws_sqs_outlet (Data Source)

Reads a Noozle AWS SQS outlet by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "noozle_aws_sqs_outlet" "alerts" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `backoff_initial_interval` (String) Initial SQS retry backoff interval.
- `backoff_max_elapsed_time` (String) Maximum total SQS retry backoff time.
- `backoff_max_interval` (String) Maximum SQS retry backoff interval.
- `batching_byte_size` (Number) Maximum bytes per SQS batch.
- `batching_check` (String) Bloblang condition for flushing an SQS batch.
- `batching_count` (Number) Maximum messages per SQS batch.
- `batching_jitter` (Number) Randomized jitter to apply to the SQS batching period.
- `batching_period` (String) Maximum wait period before flushing an SQS batch.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `delay_seconds` (Number) Delay in seconds before an SQS message becomes visible.
- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `endpoint_url` (String) AWS service endpoint URL for SQS.
- `expiry_window` (String) Expiry window for refreshed SQS credentials.
- `external_id` (String) External ID for assuming an AWS IAM role.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.
- `max_in_flight` (Number) Maximum number of in-flight SQS messages.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of SQS send retries.
- `message_deduplication_id` (String) AWS FIFO message deduplication ID.
- `message_group_id` (String) AWS FIFO message group ID.
- `metadata_exclude_prefixes` (List of String) Metadata header prefixes to exclude from SQS messages.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.
- `notify_policy` (String) Delivery policy applied when notifying this outlet.
- `profile` (String) AWS shared credential profile name for SQS.
- `queue_url` (String) AWS SQS queue URL.
- `region` (String) AWS region for SQS.
- `role_arn` (String) AWS IAM role ARN to assume for SQS.
- `use_ec2_instance_role` (Boolean) Use the EC2 instance role for SQS credentials.
